title: Pause and decide
body: Which initiative would you scale, redesign, defer or stop?
notes: Slide 27. Pause and decide. Explain that which initiative would you scale, redesign, defer or stop?. Pause for sixty seconds and ask the audience to choose one of four decisions: scale, redesign, defer or stop. Require one piece of evidence and one accountable owner.

title: Answers and reasoning
body: Strong answers expose assumptions, evidence, consequences and authority
notes: Slide 28. Answers and reasoning. Explain that strong answers expose assumptions, evidence, consequences and authority. Reveal the reasoning standard: assumptions, evidence, consequences and authority. There may be more than one defensible decision, but unsupported confidence is not acceptable.
